items.label: Quét Zone Spawn (Dear ImGui Native C++)
Quét Chuỗi RAM DinoSpawnEntries_
items.payload: PIDS=$(pidof com.studiowildcard.wardrumstudios.ark || pgrep -f ark || pgrep -f wildcard); if [ -n "$PIDS" ]; then for PID in $PIDS; do echo "[+] Đang quét RAM PID: $PID..."; grep -a -o 'DinoSpawnEntries_[A-Za-z0-9_]*' /proc/$PID/mem 2>/dev/null | sort -u; done; else echo '[-] Không tìm thấy PID game ARK Mobile!'; fi

items.label: Lọc Riêng Khu Vực Bờ Biển (Beach)
items.payload: PIDS=$(pidof com.studiowildcard.wardrumstudios.ark || pgrep -f ark || pgrep -f wildcard); if [ -n "$PIDS" ]; then for PID in $PIDS; do grep -a -o 'DinoSpawnEntries_[A-Za-z0-9_]*' /proc/$PID/mem 2>/dev/null | grep -i Beach | sort -u; done; else echo '[-] Không tìm thấy PID game ARK Mobile!'; fi

items.label: Soi Dino Đang Nhắm (APrimalDinoCharacter)

items.label: Quét Tất Cả Creatures Trong Vùng
